issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a no-argument messageOnRide() method (interface method and usages call r.messageOnRide() with no parameters and the song/strings expect "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"). The solution defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) and implements messageOnRide(int speed) in Pig and Seal. This parameter mismatch across artifacts is a structural inconsistency that will confuse students about the correct interface signature and prevent straightforward implementation following the problem/template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable interface consistent with the problem statement and template by changing messageOnRide to a no-argument method returning String (e.g. String messageOnRide()). Update implementations in Pig and Seal to implement messageOnRide() with no parameters and return strings like "Riding on Pig Doodle". Alternatively, if an int parameter is intended, update the problem statement and template usage (calls and examples) to include and document the parameter consistently.

issues.description: The problem statement and UML expect a no-argument method messageOnRide() that returns a String (the verse text "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"). The template's Main calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments. However, the solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) (and Pig/Seal implement messageOnRide(int speed) returning strings that include the speed). This mismatch in the method signature (presence of an int parameter) prevents a direct mapping between the exercise description/template usage and the solution API, likely confusing students about the correct method to implement and call.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to define Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters returning String and update Pig/Seal implementations to return "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" (removing speed), matching the problem statement and template; or (B) update the problem statement and template to specify messageOnRide(int speed) and adjust the described return value to include the speed. Preferred: implement option (A) to match the UML and text which expect a no-arg messageOnRide().
